0f0acb83.png.reason: Two broken purple lines split the tarmac into three lanes, with a solid pale edge line at each side. The left lane is filled end to end by a tall grey panel with blue and red blocks on it, sitting flat on the road with no gap underneath, so that lane is simply shut. The yellow gantry's two legs come down exactly on the two purple lines, and its hatched cross-bar hangs well clear of the road, so the middle lane is a duck-under. The right lane is bare tarmac all the way to the vanishing point.

1efba3ea.png.reason: The road reads as edge line, broken purple line, broken purple line, edge line, so three lanes; the kerb, railings and red flags on the right are outside it and don't count. The right lane has a gold-lit run-up strip ending in a low turquoise frame: two uprights with a solid bar sitting on the road between them, roughly knee height, and open air above it, which is a hurdle to jump. Left and middle are both empty tarmac. I took the middle because it is clear and still leaves me an empty lane to my left if I need it.

21f09ca0.png.reason: The yellow gantry straddles the left lane, one leg out on the left shoulder and the other on the first purple line, with its hatched bar high above a cyan-lit strip of road, so that lane is a duck-under.
